verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack addresses telemetry, usage tracking, or opt-out settings for LangGraph itself (as opposed to LangSmith tracing, which is opt-in but not discussed here). This is a fair question for an open-source framework, so absence of evidence means 'none'. Missing for 10: any documentation of telemetry collection or an opt-out flag/env var, independent confirmation of what data is collected.
